pr_title: planner: fix panic while get part of partition key values
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #22396 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: TiDB will panic while getting part of partition key values, such as we partition by the expression "a + b", it will panic while we run a query with condition that reference column a or b.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Before evolute the value of the partition expression, We check whether the expression can evolute.

How it Works: This issue occur after this pr [https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/19267](url). Before this pr, the code in `makePartitionByFnCol`:
```go
if _, ok := monotoneIncFuncs[raw.FuncName.L]; ok {
   fn = raw
   args := fn.GetArgs()
   if len(args) > 0 {
      arg0 := args[0]
      if c, ok1 := arg0.(*expression.Column); ok1 {
         col = c
      }
   }
}
```
After the pr, the code is:
```go
fn = raw
args := fn.GetArgs()
if len(args) > 0 {
   arg0 := args[0]
   if c, ok1 := arg0.(*expression.Column); ok1 {
      col = c
   }
}
```
It removes the condition and causes makePartitionByFnCol return col even if this function takes more than one variable input. And finally, the code runs to `extractDataForPrune`, and the code `constExpr.EvalInt(sctx, chunk.Row{})` panic because of lack of inputs.
And I think we can do more while the partition expression is related to more than one column. This pr just add a check before evolute the value of the partition expression.

### Related changes

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Manual test

Side effects

- None

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- No release note
